title: Why are we all so stressed?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What are the biggest sources of stress in modern life that did not exist for previous generations?
How can you tell the difference between useful pressure and harmful stress?
Which helps more when you are stressed: solving the problem, talking about it, or taking a break?
Do smartphones reduce stress by making life easier, or increase it by keeping us constantly connected?
What is one small change people could make to create a less stressful daily routine?
